decisions.reason: Substantial vulnerability batch: 91 CVEs patched in Spring framework including critical CVE-2026-59270 in Spring Security LDAP server. Over 200,000 components affected per Sonatype. High-severity RCE in Spring for GraphQL (CVE-2026-59285). 200+ Spring CVEs patched YTD vs 16 in all of 2025.

decisions.story_title: Record Federal Sentence for Tren de Aragua ATM Jackpotting
decisions.reason: Largest federal sentence for ATM jackpotting: 96 months for Juan Manuel Gouveia-Aguilera, tied to TdA. Part of 119-person prosecution in Nebraska. $3.5M in losses. Connects to broader TdA criminal operations and FBI warnings about surge in jackpotting attacks.
Promotional content for Silent Push research report on dangling DNS takeover. No specific vulnerability, CVE, or incident. Product marketing for a paid report.

Confirmed data breach at Apollo Global Management ($1.05T AUM). Social engineering/vishing attack by UNC6671/BlackFile group, July 6-10. SSNs and PII compromised. Part of broader campaign targeting major financial firms (Blackstone, Bain, KKR, Citadel, etc.). Group received $10M+ in BTC ransom payments per Google GTIG.
